race.comment: YES YOSHI (11) resumes. He was a horrible watch first up here in a good 3yo race last campaign, never getting a crack at them in the straight. He's looked very promising winning his first two starts and sets up well here for Ethan Brown. LAWBOROUGH (10) was beaten under a length in similar company at Caulfield last time out and appears to have found his sweet spot at 1100m. Drawn well for Lane, he can land handy and go close. YOLO (8) won two in a row prior to last start at Seymour when struggling. He can bounce back. WINGSANDPROPELLERS (6) was just fair fresh at Caulfield but should come on from that and maps well, consider.
